activity_summary: You stood over a sheet that carried the phrase and no title you took. The quire under your arm was blank. Fivepence left your hand. You did not write a sum on the paper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the phrase, paid, and carried blank paper out of the yard.

entities.name: fivepence
entities.context: Mentioned in The phrase, and no title

facets.activity: Took the phrase and the blank paper
